{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders: revenue == 999999.99
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Filter: only converted orders (converted == 1) and not refunded
# Also exclude QA orders
filtered_data = data[(data['converted'] == 1) & (data['status'] == 'completed') & (data['revenue'] != 999999.99)]

# Filter by channel
df_email = filtered_data[filtered_data['channel'] == 'email']
df_paid_search = filtered_data[filtered_data['channel'] == 'paid_search']

# Calculate average revenue per converted order
avg_revenue_email = df_email['revenue'].mean()
avg_revenue_paid_search = df_paid_search['revenue'].mean()

# Compute difference
revenue_diff = avg_revenue_email - avg_revenue_paid_search

# Print results
print(f'Average revenue per converted order - Email: {avg_revenue_email:.2f}')
print(f'Average revenue per converted order - Paid Search: {avg_revenue_paid_search:.2f}')
print(f'Difference (Email - Paid Search): {revenue_diff:.2f}')"}
